raw_json: {"@context":"https://schema.org/","@type":"JobPosting","title":"AIIMS NORCET 11 Nursing Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2218 Tentative Posts","description":"The All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi has released the Nursing Officer Recruitment Common Eligibility Test (NORCET)-11 Notification 2026 for the recruitment of Nursing Officer (Group-B) posts. The online application process started on 24 July 2026 and will remain open until 13 August 2026 (5:00 PM). Candidates possessing B.Sc. Nursing, Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing, or GNM with the required experience and Nursing Council registration are eligible to apply.
